description: This file defines a Flask route for health checking, using Flask-Smorest's Blueprint and Flask's MethodView to create an endpoint that returns a health status message.

classes.name: HealthCheck
classes.description: A Flask MethodView class handling GET requests at the root URL, returning a health status message.

methods.name: get(self)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the health check endpoint, returning a JSON message indicating health status.

ctags.pattern: /^blp = Blueprint("Healt Check", "health check", url_prefix="\/", description="Health check route"/
